general: Mundo's early game is very weak: don't fight, invade or join river skirmishes; poke with Q and especially E (it goes through minions) and only go in once the opponent is low. Use W to absorb big burst abilities, which you can then heal off. At level 6 use R mainly to regenerate rather than mid-fight. Around levels 8-9 you can start taking longer fights, rank 2 ult in the mid game makes you a real threat, and rank 3 ult is your peak, when you can walk into the enemy team and threaten carries (build Titanic Hydra before Overlord's Bloodmail). %HP damage remains your biggest weakness at every stage. Mid game, match or out-push split pushers with E waveclear, and keep forcing weak side-laners to answer you while you take turrets.
